Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 (Section 63) / Indian Evidence Act, 1872 (Section 65B)

statutory_questions.topic: IT Rules Rule 3(1)(h) 180-day WORM retention vs DPDP Section 12(3) Right to Erasure

blocking_reason: Formal signed written legal opinion from practicing Indian technology and cyber law counsel is required prior to GA promotion. Legal interpretations and regulatory compliance cannot be synthetically generated or self-certified.
